notes: Only 3 of the page's 10 styles encode as deterministic serial rules from the page text: page styles 2, 7 and 10. Page style 1 carries no serial encoding (year and month read only from the printed manufacture-date label) and is not encoded. Page styles 3, 4, 5, 6, 8 and 9 decode through charts shown only as images on the page; the chart contents are not recoverable from the page text, so no tables are encoded for them and they are held as gaps pending a read of the chart images. Related brands Goodman, Amana and Janitrol are listed on the page but use their own serial systems; no styles are copied from them and usesStylesOf is null. Two-digit years resolve by the schema century rule with floor 1960. Example decodes are derived mechanically from the page's documented positions (the page states positions, not manufactured-in sentences, for these three styles).

styles.era: Page style 2: 4-letter prefix followed by 10 digits
styles.notes: Page style 2: year is the 5th and 6th characters (first two digits after the 4-letter prefix), month is the 7th and 8th characters. Example decode derived from the documented positions: 09 -> 2009, 05 -> May.

styles.era: Page style 7: 1 letter followed by 9 digits
styles.notes: Page style 7: year is the 2nd and 3rd digits, week is the 4th and 5th digits. Example decode derived from the documented positions: 88 -> 1988, week 12.
Page style 10: year is the 1st and 2nd numbers, month is the 3rd and 4th numbers. Example decode derived from the documented positions: 16 -> 2016, 02 -> February.
